info.desc: "Absolution" is the third studio album by English alternative rock band Muse. It was released on September 21, 2003 in the UK and on March 23, 2004 in the U.S. by Taste Music Limited. The album yielded the band's first big American hits - "Time Is Running Out" and "Hysteria", the former becoming their first UK Top 10 single. Recently it was voted the 21st best British album ever. The band spent much of 2002 recording Absolution with producer Rich Costey. The album was recorded in studios in both Los Angeles and London. Bellamy said that the band made a .

podcast.body: This album is considered to have received the best critical reception to date. It was an ambitious project involving nearly a year of recording, a change of producer, and yielded six singles. It was conceived as a conceptual album, establishing the deep, characteristic Mios sound with influences from romantic classical composers like Rachmaninoff, and an epic, conceptual approach to album creation. "Absolution" was their first number one album and significantly elevated the band's status, despite some critics finding it too epic or similar to Queen, and its conceptual nature not fully realized compared to bands like Pink Floyd. "Este fue su primer número uno, yo creo que aquí ya se asentaron las bases del mismo de todo modo aunque fue el mejor diseñado de la banda que trajo importantísimas mejoras y que trajo un álbum absolutamente épico."
